heads.en: OpenAI pushed GPT-6.2 two models with a 20 per cent surge in performance and a 20 per cent drop in prison escape, and OpenAI announced two new artificial intelligence models, GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol, which were posted on the ChatGPTwork, Codex and API platforms at 17th. This update is based on the fact that Astra is dedicated to high-risk professional tasks and Sol is responsible for day-to-day work, attracting high global corporate attention. OpenAI has stressed that Astra has taken a significant 20 per cent reduction in previous generations in a number of evaluations, but has admitted that the model has regressed in the defense and surveillance of prison escape. According to official announcements, the two models were used only by specific paying users, and Astra was marked for the first time as a self-improvement for AI. 2 minutes ago, OpenAI pushed GPT-6.2 models.
